h: Shabbos Brings Divine Protection Beyond Our Own Understanding

p: In the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 81a):
rather, in one who is perfected
And above the holy Zohar says
and covers himself with the covering of the mitzvah,
And they have already raised a difficulty on this,
and what they wrote to distinguish
between a tallis katan and a tallis gadol
לֹא נִרְאֶה כֵּן עַל פִּי דִּין
does not appear so according to halachah
(as is written in the Tur and Shulchan Aruch,
Also, what is written in the name of the Ramaz,
that the holy Zohar did not choose its words precisely,
that the attribute of Kesser Elyon is called a crown,
and a crown is on the head;
and in the Midrash (Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:9
and in the Pesikta ("Sos Asis") it says
that the Holy One, blessed be He, put on
that the Holy One, blessed be He, emanated
for the creation of the world;
and it calls even the attribute of Kesser Elyon
and a garment is over the whole body,
not only a crown on the head.
Hashem my God, You are very great";
all grasp of the human intellect.
and this is the first garment;
"He wraps Himself in light as a garment,"
which is the garment of Chochmah,
which is the utterance "Let there be light";
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה ג, ד)
This teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, wrapped Himself in it
'He wraps Himself in light as a garment'";
If so, the garment of majesty and splendor
which is the crown on the head;
and tzitzis is the surrounding light.
And earlier, when one puts on tzitzis,
although it is a protection from the evil inclination,
"And you shall see it and remember, etc.,"
שֶׁעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (בְּרָכוֹת סא, א)
about which they said in the Gemara (Berachos 61a):
sits between the two openings of the heart";
sits on "the heart of the wise at his right"
and makes himself as though enticing him
And even with Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
"He appeared to him like a Torah scholar,"
and he attached himself to his right,
making himself out as guiding him for good;
but Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
sensed immediately that it was not so,
and he could not overcome him;
But after one has been crowned with tefillin,
then the tallis of mitzvah becomes
by which Hashem Yisbarach guards him
in the name of the Yerushalmi:
(מִשְׁלֵי ג, כו) כִּי ה׳ יִהְיֶה בְכִסְלֶךָ
in matters in which you are a fool";
the intellect hidden from all thought
and so we say these verses
And this is what it says in the holy Zohar:
and covers himself with the covering of the mitzvah";
for after putting on the tefillin,
then he merits that the covering of the mitzvah,
be a garment of surrounding light;
and then "and He is in One":
for he merits that the Hidden,
the revelation of Atika, which is called "He,"
for He guards him beyond his grasp.
that at the morning meal of Shabbos,
one merits the revelation of Atika:
אַךְ בִּסְעוּדָה שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
but at the meal of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
which is the revelation of the Forehead of Atika,
the first garment, majesty and splendor,
and it is a surrounding light
beyond the grasp of human intellect.
in the song of this meal:
which is the husk of Amalek,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ב סה, א)
as is written (in the Zohar II 65a).
And Amalek is the evil inclination,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק ג קס, א)
as is written (in the Zohar III 160a):
(בְּמִדְבַּר יג, כט) עֲמָלֵק יוֹשֵׁב בְּאֶרֶץ הַנֶּגֶב
"'Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev' (Bamidbar 13:29)
which is found constantly in the body."
And it is the root of the evil inclination,
which disguises itself to show itself
as a guide to the good path,
to Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him;
and from this one merits to be saved
is for the good, from Hashem Yisbarach,
since I came into being, etc.";
the Holy One, blessed be He, guarded him
וְכֵן דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם אָמַר
And likewise Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him, said (Tehillim 23):
"Hashem is my shepherd, I shall not lack;
He leads me in paths of righteousness"
that everything is from Hashem Yisbarach;
about the incident that befell him,
which it did not enter his mind
that he was committing a sin,
from the six days of Creation, etc.";
and after he heard from the prophet,
"Though I walk in the valley of the shadow of death,
You will refine all my deeds
that willful sins become like merits.
And so we say this psalm

p: (תְּהִלִּים קטז, יג) כּוֹס יְשׁוּעוֹת אֶשָּׂא וְגוֹ׳
"I will raise the cup of salvations, etc." (Tehillim 116:13),
וּפָסוּק זֶה נִזְכַּר בַּגְּמָרָא (פְּסָחִים קיט, ב)
And this pasuk is mentioned in the Gemara (Pesachim 119b),
at the feast of the future;
that it is a cup of salvations,
for there will be salvation in truth;
why is it called a cup of salvations?
But it is as I said,
that on Shabbos there is aroused in the heart
"Answer us with the truth of Your salvation"
"the lip of truth is established forever";
And therefore the cup of Havdalah is called
after the wiping out of Amalek,
where it is written, "And they had rest from their enemies,"
which is rest from the evil inclination,
(מִשְׁלֵי טז, ז) גַּם אוֹיְבָיו יַשְׁלִים אִתּוֹ
"'Even his enemies He makes at peace with him' (Mishlei 16:7)
"The Jews had light and joy, etc.";
when one merits rest from the evil inclination,
we say this pasuk at Havdalah:
"The Jews had light and joy, etc.";
for all these things are present on Shabbos:
we say at the morning meal,
"Those who keep Shabbos will rejoice in Your kingship,"
and Shabbos is called "the day of your rejoicing"
and Shabbos is in the secret of the covenant
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב צב, א)
this is the tefillin of the head,
and that is the revelation of Atika,
which is the crown on the head;
and Shabbos has in it the revelation of Atika.
also for the days of work.
